text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm out shopping...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I notice Эйсин Флэш standing in front of
a store
wearing a troubled expression.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I came here to buy stollen, but it seems
the store
is closed because the owner
had to step out on
emergency business.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This will cause major delays in my plans.
I had not
accounted for this. What ever
should I do?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: I'm sure there's another store that sells it.

text_block_list.text:
This will cause major delays in my plans.
I had not
accounted for this. What ever
should I do?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: I'm sure there's another store that sells it.

text_block_list.text:
I have never thought to do that, but you
are quite
right.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If I cannot buy any, then I can simply
make some.
Thankfully, I am able to
recall its flavor vividly.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If I use my parents' recipe as a base, it
should be
possible to reproduce the
taste.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You are quite correct. Considering the
current
situation, I should have prepared
alternate
choices.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, my current plans consist of
taking a
stroll and buying stollen along
the way.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
As the task of finding another store falls
within
the category of taking a stroll, my
plans remain
intact.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I must make every effort to find another
store
before the time frame for these
tasks passes!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your words of advice. I
shall look
for another store at once.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your words of advice. I
shall return
to my dorm to make it at
once.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
